Re-verified all 12 design domains against CURRENT code on disk (clean worktree, HEAD c2fcbf00 — newer than both the convergence report's 50d55e5e and the §3 audit's 95721cbe baseline). RESULT: all 12 domains (D1-D12) are GREEN. No non-green domains.

- D3.1 (execution_fingerprint), D2.1 (put_config if_match/etag), D9 (get_release + atomic stage/rollback), D6.1 (SSOT six-state word table), D8.4 (subgraph absolute path), D11 (EventEnvelope), D7 (per-node golden), D5 (opaque secret-handle), D12 (desktop-only sole writer, no HTTP fallback) — all verified present in current code.
